description: Build an agent-consumable reproduction pack: evidence (timeline, status, env) separate from inference (AI summary). Prefer occurrenceId so sessions are not interleaved. Not raw rrweb. Same pack as resources/read bugtape://bugs/{bugId}/repro. For an example bug (isExample: true) the pack is practice data and costs no credits.

eventLimit.description: Max raw events to scan before summarizing

occurrenceId.description: Pin to one occurrence. If omitted, uses the latest occurrence when available.
